title: Hook, Script, Agent & Worktree Orchestration
brief: Reconcile hook truth source. Implement phase-aware hook activation. Define script recommendation rules. Coordinate agent teams with existing forge-team/pipeline-team patterns. Add telemetry for orchestration quality.

units.title: Reconcile hook truth: single source between settings.json, CLAUDE.md, and hook scripts
Implement phase-aware hook activation: activate/deactivate hooks based on current workflow phase
Define script recommendation rules: suggest scripts based on detected work class
Agent team coordination: integrate with forge-team/pipeline-team patterns for multi-agent work
Worktree orchestration: coordinate worktree lifecycle with agent teams and hook phases
Add orchestration telemetry: hook fire rates, script usage, agent team outcomes

exit_conditions: Hook truth reconciled to single source
Agent teams coordinated with existing patterns
